depiction.primary_object: two curved clockwise arrows forming a circle
depiction.composition: two curved arrows chasing each other clockwise in a loop

ambiguity: Easily confused with single-arrow reload/rotate icons, three-arrow recycling symbols, or camera-flip UI buttons.

set up a recurring habit or routine
renew an expiring subscription or license
convert or roll over an account

reasoning: The icon depicts two curved arrows forming a clockwise circle, universally recognized as sync, refresh, repeat, or swap/rotate. While abstract, it is the best icon for data synchronization, item exchanges, physical rotations (mattresses, stock), and recurring routines, though it must not be overused for generic 'update' tasks that have a concrete object.
